objective: Close a concrete false-negative in policy-only reassessment: a registered system changes tags or evidence while requirements remain unchanged. Retain original requirement validation and financial/owner custody. Construct a source-bound bidirectional impact reviewer, not a compliance verdict.
preregistered_adverse_counterexample: Unchanged requirement applies to tag 'decision'. System 'x' initially tagged 'prototype', after revision tagged 'decision'; unchanged evidence refs. v1 returns no reassessments. v2 must include (x, requirement), disclose missing controls, and withhold compliance verdict.
protocol: Accept exact before/after requirement and before/after system snapshots; reject malformed, duplicate identifiers, same-version changed requirement, unsafe JSON duplicates.
Inspect old and new applicability. Queue a pair if applicable in either snapshot AND its requirement OR its system differs across snapshots, including additions and retirements.
Preserve both sides' linked evidence and unlinked controls, with no source authentication implied, no automated compliance outcome and deterministic receipt SHA-256.
Compare against independent unoptimized exhaustive O(R*S) script with same rights/data. Report any control tie, not manufactured economic superiority.
Use synthetic AI-governance A and different synthetic supplier-quality B with disclosed fixture assumptions; no real beneficiary, paid contract, legal interpretation or revenue claims.
Predeclared fixed randomized cross-check seeds 230041 and 230042; no resampling, no seed changes after outcomes.

Test the original upstream negative control independently on the same adverse case without editing it. It is a bounded missing-feature demonstration, not a retroactive failure of its original declared protocol.
All 12 named adverse tests and both examples must succeed. A failing attempt remains failed with cause; only separately labeled repaired run can qualify.
scope: Independent additive research; no native account or financial actions, no paid API, government access, private records, buyer communications, spending, bid, production release or merging into main.
exit: If missing-feature corrected, retain engineering result only. Separate rights-cleared representative data, competent current commercial suites, beneficiary acceptance, measured complete costs, released-byte proof and causal transfer are still necessary.
